newsitem.title: UK: London stocks end lower as Wall St worries weigh.
newsitem.headline: London stocks end lower as Wall St worries weigh.

text.p: UK shares finished moderately lower on Tuesday as investors remained nervous about a possible Wall Street slide after its recent weakness.
Although the Dow has dropped five percent since hitting an all-time peak last month, many market participants believe U.S. blue chips are due for a more substantial correction.
"People are looking for excuses to sell this market not to buy it," the head of trading at a large brokerage said.
"The Dow looks like it's headed lower. It really depends now on how much we (FTSE) follow it."
The FTSE 100 index ended 14.2 points down at 3,979.6.
